leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute-force solution to find the next greater element for each element in an array
Construct a stack-based algorithm to optimize the next greater element search
Initialize and manipulate a stack data structure to track elements while traversing the array
Apply the next greater element algorithm to solve problems with integer arrays
Configure the algorithm to handle edge cases like duplicate values and descending sequences
Integrate the next greater element logic into a complete JavaScript function
Update the algorithm to return appropriate results when no greater element exists
